t: New: Navi – second display with a moving map (aerial photo or street map), connected by radio (ESP-NOW)
Settings, status and Navi update under Display → Navi, new tile Navi status
Display cockpit: Pitch is only shown when the car lies on its roof (no more red band for small tilt)
Display tile GPS: shows only the number of satellites (no Fix)
Web display preview: Big values without footer line, like on the display
Web page: Core IP now in the Wi-Fi line after the network name (IP: …), removed next to Mojave
Display tiles: titles bigger, shrink only so far that they never touch the edge
Tile Battery: title shows only the cell count (e.g. BATT 4S), no total voltage
Display: last German words replaced – tiles now show on / off / ready instead of an / aus / bereit
Display → Layout: new Big values – 1 to 3 values as big as possible (choose them in the Big values card)
Web page: Core IP address shown at the top next to Mojave
Display tile Battery shows only the cell voltage (bigger)
New display tile Battery % (choose it in Display → Tiles, e.g. instead of Used mAh)
Devil eyes: new Eye style Reptile – yellow snake eyes, slit pupil opens and closes, scales, side blink
Devil eyes are now much scarier: bloodshot eyes with veins, glowing slit pupils, twitching looks, flicker and blood tears
Display: new setting Brightness (%) – needs the display BLK wire on GPIO 20 (see new wiring plan)
Display backlight is switched off when the display is off
System → Online update: field Update address removed – the Core always uses the standard update address
Display → After arm: new choice Devil eyes – while armed the display shows only two angry eyes (no values)
Eye color, eye speed and Test eyes (12 s) in Display settings
Display: the arm block message (e.g. Throttle not low) now stays steady instead of pulsing
Fix: display tile FC showed the speed instead of FC status and RSSI
Fix arm animation, double press 500 ms, battery tile cell count, Indicators line removed
Arm animation (non-blocking), After-arm display mode, tile messages in footer
